entities.name: Query protein 346 aa
observations: Sequence length is 346 aa; estimated molecular weight is 37.6 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.90.
Contains a Pfam PFK domain (PF00365.26) spanning residues 5–301.
Has 88.2% identity and 100% alignment coverage to reviewed UniProt Q9KH71, a pyrophosphate--fructose 6-phosphate 1-phosphotransferase.
Strong homology supports assignment as a PPi-dependent phosphofructokinase, but exact substrate usage is inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: Pyrophosphate phosphofructokinase
observations: Catalyzes reversible phosphorylation of D-fructose 6-phosphate using inorganic pyrophosphate as phosphoryl donor, producing fructose 1,6-bisphosphate and phosphate.
EC number is 2.7.1.90; associated Rhea reaction is RHEA:13613.
Requires Mg2+ and is generally cytoplasmic; characterized homologs form dimers, tetramers, or dimer/tetramer assemblies depending on organism.
Functions in glycolysis and can support gluconeogenic direction because the PPi-driven reaction is reversible.

entities.name: Glycolysis
observations: Pyrophosphate phosphofructokinase catalyzes the committed fructose-6-phosphate phosphorylation step of glycolysis and participates in fructose 1,6-bisphosphate metabolism.
